sections.title: How Does Heroin Impact the Body?
body: Heroin can be used in a variety of methods, including intravenously and smoking. There are slight differences in the time it takes a person to feel the effects of heroin based on the method it is used in. Regardless, heroin abuse changes the way our brain functions. Heroin binds to the opioid receptors in our brain, which leads to the euphoria that individuals experience.
Similar to other substances, heroin disrupts our brain’s natural reward system and leads to an excessive amount of dopamine being released.

sections.title: How to Treat Heroin Addiction?

Detoxification can provide you with emotional support as well as comfort medications to ease your withdrawal symptoms, when appropriate. Detox programs will also help you determine what the next right step would be for you and your recovery.

Other treatment options that can benefit individuals who are struggling with heroin are inpatient and outpatient treatment options. All of these treatment options have different criteria to ensure that individuals receive the proper care and support for their unique situations.
